Binance Says It Blocked Multiple North Korea-Linked Cyberattacks Over the Past Week, With No Asset Losses Binance said on October 27 that its security team had successfully identified and blocked multiple North Korea-linked cyberattacks over the past week, with no damage to company systems or loss of assets. Binance noted that North Korea-linked hacking groups have continued to conduct social engineering attacks under the “Contagious Interview” campaign, using fake job interviews, coding tests, and software installation requests to trick targets into running malicious programs. The exchange advised users to avoid installing unauthorized software or executing code from untrusted sources, adding that it will continue strengthening security monitoring, threat detection, and internal security controls. — link

Arkham: Justin Sun-Linked Wallets Hold $51.25M in PEPE, Accounting for 2.82% of Supply According to Arkham, wallets it has labeled or tentatively attributed to Justin Sun collectively hold approximately $51.25 million in PEPE, representing 2.82% of the token's total supply, potentially making him the largest individual PEPE holder. Arkham tracked two transfers from Poloniex to the associated wallets on October 17 and 26, worth approximately $28.44 million and $20.32 million, respectively, totaling $48.76 million. Between October 15 and 25, wallets already labeled as belonging to Sun also transferred approximately $77 million in stablecoins to Poloniex. Some of the PEPE had previously moved between Binance, HTX and Poloniex. — link

Genius Launches Mobile App Integrating Token Trading, Creation, and Social Features on BNB Chain Onchain trading platform Genius has launched its mobile app on Apple's App Store and Google Play. Built on BNB Chain, it combines token trading, social features, and token creation. Users can trade cryptocurrencies, follow other traders, explore market activity, and share insights from their phones. Integrated Genius fun lets users create tokens, select trading pairs, and launch new tokens. Genius fun launched on BNB Chain in September, and the new app brings these existing features to mobile. — link

Coinbase to Automatically Convert 14 Restricted Crypto Assets for EEA Users on October 30 Under Coinbase's previously announced MiCA compliance measures, retail users in the European Economic Area (EEA) must withdraw 14 restricted crypto assets, including USDT, PYUSD, USD1, DAI, and PAXG, before October 30. On that date, Coinbase will automatically convert remaining balances into USDC or other supported assets or currencies at prevailing market rates. Trading and conversions of these assets have already been restricted. Coinbase warned that deposits received after the deadline will not be credited to user accounts or included in the automatic conversion process, and recovery cannot be guaranteed. The restrictions affect assets issued by Tether, PayPal, and Trump-linked World Liberty Financial, among others. — link
